channel.title: AI Builder's Field Guide — Recently Added
channel.description: A daily-curated wiki of the tools, models, and patterns that AI power-users and builders actually reach for.

item.title: Firecrawl
item.description: A web scraping and data extraction API designed to provide clean, structured web content for AI agents and developers. — It streamlines the process of feeding high-quality, structured web data to AI agents, enhancing their ability to perform accurate information retrieval.

item.title: Termi Protocol
item.description: A 3D simulation environment for visualizing, monitoring, and debugging AI agent workflows. — It offers a unique visual approach to understanding complex agent interactions, providing more intuitive insights than traditional log-based debugging for multi-agent systems.

item.title: Google ADK (Agent Development Kit)
item.description: Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK) is an open-source, code-first framework for building, evaluating, and deploying sophisticated AI agents, optimized for the Google ecosystem. — ADK provides a modular approach to agent development, enabling flexible orchestration of multi-agent systems and integrating with Google Cloud services for enterprise-scale deployment. This offers a comprehensive solution for developers already using Google's stack, similar to how Microsoft Agent Framework caters to its ecosystem.

item.title: NVIDIA Dynamo
item.description: NVIDIA Dynamo is an open-source distributed inference framework for serving large language models efficiently across multi-node GPU environments. — It significantly boosts throughput and reduces latency for LLM inference by introducing innovations like disaggregated prefill and decode, dynamic GPU scheduling, and KV cache management. This provides a high-performance solution for scaling generative AI models in production, offering a specialized alternative to general-purpose inference solutions.

item.title: Meetily
item.description: Meetily is a self-hosted, open-source AI meeting assistant providing live transcription, speaker diarization, and summarization. — It offers 100% local processing, ensuring privacy for meeting notes without relying on cloud services, unlike many commercial alternatives.

item.title: OmniRoute
item.description: OmniRoute is a free AI gateway that provides a single endpoint to access over 231 AI model providers with token compression and auto-fallback. — It simplifies multi-model integration, optimizes inference costs through token savings, and enhances reliability by intelligently routing requests and handling failures.

item.title: Hyper
item.description: Hyper is a shared company brain that integrates internal information to enhance AI agents and automations by providing persistent, context-rich knowledge. — It addresses the critical challenge of context loss for AI agents, allowing them to retain company-specific information across sessions and improve performance on long-horizon tasks.

item.title: AgentVerse (OpenBMB)
item.description: AgentVerse is an open-source framework designed for deploying multiple LLM-based agents in task-solving and simulation applications. — It offers a structured approach for building and evaluating multi-agent systems, providing a comprehensive environment for complex AI workflows.
